coverage.description: Speech keeps main act then additional acts without deduplication; Event.role returns first matching role, all retains duplicate roles in order, has projects participant IDs, happened requires not negated and branch real. Event state references are frozen values. Cursor/Text/Gate formatting is deterministic. World construction starts empty with document world 0, real branch, chapter 1 and a Story. Entity map access follows BTree key order; event lookup takes first matching ID. Public apply validates position, clones the full world, dispatches apply_root when story is Some and apply_local otherwise, then commits only on success. apply_local directly executes and validates links, adds strictly increasing sorted anchored mentions for touched existing entities, and returns new event IDs.
